thread:
micah: Pushing v3.14.0 to green pool now. Plan is to do a deferred drain and staggered batch shift to avoid p95 spikes. tagging @router-oncall and @engops. deploy-bot will handle the traffic batches.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout: v3.14.0 -> green. Batch plan: [10% -> 20% -> 40% -> 100%]. Hold 5m between steps. Auto-rollback on 3x p95 increase OR 5% error-rate above baseline.

sophie: Quick Q — are we pinning session-affinity to blue during the drain to avoid cross-cookie churn?

omar: yes, we'll set session_affinity: sticky for 1h on blue while drain is in progress. snippet:```routerctl set-affinity blue sticky --ttl=3600```

katie: Can we also add a short blurb in the release notes about the feature flag toggle and the config change? Customer success asked to see the note before EOD.

micah: noted. I'll add release notes + rollback instructions. Also, decision: if the first 10% shows >2% 5xx or p95 +30% we'll revert to 0% and trigger incident playbook.

router-oncall: Running a quick health probe on green before shift. CTRL output: `200 OK, latencies p50=12ms p95=62ms p99=210ms` — baseline compared to blue p95=58ms. Looks close.

router-bot: Canary probe passed (7/7) for green in us-west1. Reporting metrics to /releases/3180011122.

engops: Heads-up: there is a minor maintenance window on infra-db at 02:20 UTC. Recommend we avoid final 100% cutover during that 20m window. Suggest doing bulk shift now and schedule 100% after 03:00 UTC.

micah: Good catch. We'll do 10->40% now, pause before infra-db window, then finish ramp after 03:00 UTC.

sophie: For rollback quickness, can we pre-create a pin override? Example config below to force route back to blue:```curl -XPOST https://router-api.internal/override -d '{"route":"service-x","force":"blue","reason":"rollback-3180011122"}'```

omar: I'll pre-stage the override and leave instructions in the playbook. If we hit rollback criteria deploy-bot will apply it automatically if manual ack not received in 3m.

deploy-bot: Applying batch 1 -> 10% now. Watch /dash/releases/3180011122 for live metrics.

katie: Logged release note draft in PR #4821. Short summary + link to change window.

micah: Batch 1 steady at 10% for 5m. p95 +2% (within tolerance), errors 0.9% (baseline 0.8%). Proceeding to 20%.

deploy-bot: Batch 2 -> 20% applied. Monitoring.

router-oncall: No sign of tail latency regressions. p99 unchanged. Still good.

micah: We're pausing at 40% before infra-db window. Leave the pre-staged rollback in place. Everyone keep eyes on releases dash. If anything looks off, call it and we abort. :eyes:

router-bot: Paused at 40% as requested. Alert rules armed: p95 > baseline*1.5 or error-rate > baseline + 3% will trigger automated rollback.

engops: After the DB window we can resume with a short smoke at 60% then 100%. I'll coordinate with infra-db lead to confirm the window cleared.

sophie: Post-shift checklist: 1) confirm KV cache warm 2) validate sticky sessions 3) confirm metrics exported to ingestion.

micah: Copy that. I'll run the checklist before final cutover.

omar: One more note — if we need a manual hotfix rollback for model config, tag @micah and @omar, deploy-bot will revert route but we may need to rollback config separately.

katie: I'll send a quick broadcast in #general once we're at 100% and stability is confirmed.

micah: Thanks team. Keeping the thread open; will update when we resume after infra-db window.

deploy-bot: Final note logged: rollout paused at 40% (reason: infra-db maintenance). Automation will resume at 03:05 UTC unless manual override.
